title: Multipartite entanglement in the quantum tetrahedron
summary: The space Inv$(j_1,j_2,j_3,j_4)$ of SU(2)-invariant four-valent tensors, also known as intertwiners, can be understood as the quantum states of a tetrahedron in Euclidean space with fixed areas. In loop quantum gravity, they are states of the smallest ``atom of space" with non-zero volume. At the same time they correspond to four-party tensor product states invariant under global rotations. We consider the multipartite entanglement of states in Inv$(j_1,j_2,j_3,j_4)$ using the recently proposed entropic fill.
